question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT 
    mc.PID,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) as yr
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mc.PID, TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER)
),
actor_year_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    yr,
    LAG(yr) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY yr) as prev_yr
  FROM actor_years
),
actors_with_gap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID
  FROM actor_year_gaps
  WHERE prev_yr IS NOT NULL AND yr - prev_yr >= 5
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) FROM actor_years) as total_actors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actors_with_gap) as actors_with_gap,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) FROM actor_years) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actors_with_gap) as expected_without_gap
